page-structure.evidence: Heading order has two level-skips: h2->h4 (TEACHERS) and h2->h6 (Popular flashcard sets), flagged by axe heading-order. Two h1 elements present (best-practice concern, not a WCAG SC). Heading sequence also includes h6->h5 step-up and h2->h1 reappearance for sign-up section, creating a confusing outline. Title 'Quizlet: Study Tools & Learning Resources for Students and Teachers | Quizlet' is descriptive (2.4.2 PASSES). Landmarks: hasMain=true, hasNav=true, 16 landmarks total with 5 labelled navs in footer. Axe flags landmark-banner-is-top-level (div role=banner inside header), landmark-no-duplicate-banner, and landmark-unique violations. Page content outside landmarks flagged by axe 'region' rule (maintenance banner div).

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 5 ul/ol elements with list-style:none and no role='list' attribute, risking list semantics stripping in VoiceOver/Safari (WebKit-specific). Popular flashcard sets are card links that appear grouped visually but are wrapped in plain div containers without list/group semantics. Footer navs use proper <ul>/<li> and SR walk confirms they read with list positions (e.g., 'listitem, level 1, position 3, set size 15'). Birthday fields (Month/Day/Year selects) in sign-up form grouped visually under 'Birthday' label div but no fieldset/role=group programmatically associates the label — AT users may not know the three selects relate to birthday. Tab walk order follows DOM order which matches visual top-to-bottom order; no reading-order reversal detected.

reflow.evidence: verify-finding.js at 320x900: scrollW=320, clientW=320, overflow=false. Page reflows to single column without horizontal scroll. bodyLen=3737 confirms content rendered.
